newsitem.title: GERMANY: German consumer confidence gains in January-ICON.
newsitem.headline: German consumer confidence gains in January-ICON.

text.p: Consumer confidence in Germany rose surprisingly strongly in January, but the overall climate remains gloomy, according to the ICON index published on Wednesday.

The index, compiled by ICON Wirtschaftsforschung in Nuremberg, climbed to 91 points in January -- up three points from the previous month as well as on a year earlier. The January result extends an uptrend which began last summer.
But it still remains well below the 100-point level which would indicate an even balance between optimists and pessimists among the 2,000 consumers surveyed in western Germany.
ICON said the pickup in confidence was linked to expectations of higher incomes, as well as greater readiness among consumers to spend rather than save.
But consumers remained "extremely sceptical" about record German unemployment and the overall economic situation.
ICON has been commissioned by the European Commission to carry out its monthly consumer survey.
